details:
I adjusted the radial slider for a float parameter in my avatar. I was just far enough away from my friends watching me for two of them to not receive the parameter update until I walked back towards them, and for one of them to receive the update and see my hair's hue change to the same color as I saw. One of them however seemed to get a partial update from that distance, seeing a color 0.12 higher than the starting color, but not getting the full value change to match what I saw. 

When I returned to the group, this friend was permanently stuck seeing my hair's hue value at 0.12 higher than what everyone else saw.

We tried having the friend hide and unhide my avatar, this did not resolve the issue. 

I tried changing my hue slider repeatedly while we were in close proximity, including setting it to 0.0 and 1.0, but the hair color the friend could see was always 0.12 higher than the actual value.

The friend had to log off at that time anyway so we did not test other methods to correct the desync.

The avatar I was wearing for this uses an fx controller with Write Defaults On. I have not tested it with an avatar with WD Off.
title: New and Persistent Avatar Parameter Desync Possible at some distances.
